items.description:

items.title: Security forces kill 5 terrorists in North Waziristan IBO: state media
items.description:
Security forces on Tuesday killed five terrorists in an intelligence-based operation (IBO) in North Waziristan, state broadcaster Radio Pakistan reported.
Two terrorists were injured in the operation, it said.
Forces targeted hideouts of the terrorists, who belonged to Fitna al-Khawarij, according to security sources.
Fitna al Khawarij is a term the state uses for terrorists belonging to the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan.

items.title: Tens of thousands expected in Paris for high school protests
items.description:
Tens of thousands of demonstrators are expected on the streets of Paris on Tuesday as France’s powerful trade unions join high school students rallying for better conditions in a wave of protests marked by clashes with police.
Students have blocked the entrances to hundreds of high schools for 15- to 17-year-olds since late September, complaining of missing teachers, overloaded timetables, dilapidated classrooms and buildings that cannot cope with rising temperatures.

items.title: Last ruler of Khairpur State passes away
items.description:
SUKKUR: Mir Ali Murad Khan Talpur, the last ruler of the former princely state of Khairpur, passed away here on Monday. He was 93.
He has left behind two sons and a daughter.
The funeral prayers will be offered at Kot Diji on Tuesday (today) at 11am.
The late Talpur played a significant role in the history of Khairpur State during the transition following the creation of Pakistan.
After Pakistan came into being, he placed his trust in Quaid-i-Azam Mohammad Ali Jinnah and signed an instrument of accession of Khairpur State to Pakistan.
